verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's structure: the quote mark sits top-left, then the quote, then the attribution in a left column, with the can and circle on the right. It needs fixes before shipping. 'too soon.' is left alone on the last line. The SOLSTICE logo is centred under the column instead of sitting on the text's left edge, and it is larger than in the original. B wraps the quote into 5 cramped lines that start almost at the top edge. Its quote mark hangs at mid-height beside the text, which looks arbitrary. The attribution is enlarged until it competes with the quote, and the logo again floats off-axis.
